import hashlib,re
source=Path('lib/jeff-busy-beaver-zfc254/ZF/m254/coq/tm/Prog254.v')

section=source.read_text().split('Definition p254_tab : list (cedge * cedge) := [',1)[1].split('].',1)[0]
pattern=r'\((CN \d+|CI \d+|CD \d+|CB \d+|CC \d+|CH), (CN \d+|CI \d+|CD \d+|CB \d+|CC \d+|CH)\)'
assert not re.sub(pattern,'',section).replace(';','').strip()
def edge(token):
    tag,*value=token.split()
    return {'CN':'node','CI':'inc','CD':'decnz','CB':'brk','CC':'cont','CH':'halt'}[tag], int(value[0]) if value else None
rows=[tuple(map(edge,pair)) for pair in re.findall(pattern,section)]
lean=Path('Computability/BusyBeaver/Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/Prog254.lean').read_text()
emitted=re.findall(r'\(\.(node|inc|decnz|brk|cont|halt)(?: (\d+))?, \.(node|inc|decnz|brk|cont|halt)(?: (\d+))?\), -- (\d+)',lean)
assert len(rows)==len(emitted)==6459
for i,(a,b,c,d,index) in enumerate(emitted):
    assert int(index)==i and rows[i]==((a,int(b) if b else None),(c,int(d) if d else None))
refs=re.findall(r'\.leaf block(\d+)',lean.split('def literalTree : RowTree :=',1)[1].split('/-- The 6459 original',1)[0])
assert list(map(int,refs))==list(range(101))
blocks=re.findall(r'private def block(\d+) : List Row := \[(.*?)\n\]',lean,re.S)
assert len(blocks)==101
assert [len(re.findall(r' -- \d+',body)) for _,body in blocks]==[64]*100+[59]
print('PASS: all 6459 literal rows, source indices, block sizes and tree block order')
